description: A medium fiddle-leaf fig with a slender woody trunk and broad glossy violin-shaped dark green leaves with pale veins, one branching crown
A large bird-of-paradise foliage plant with tall arching upright stems and large elegant paddle-shaped green leaves, some naturally split tips, one small orange flower
A small lush Calathea orbifolia with broad round pale sage leaves striped in silver and dark green, compact layered ground clump
A medium Alocasia Polly with angular arrowhead-shaped deep dark green leaves, striking pale ivory veins, scalloped edges and upright stems
A small spreading Boston fern with many finely segmented bright emerald arching fronds, graceful dense rosette
A medium golden pothos with gold and green marbled heart leaves, a short mossy branch support, vines trailing sideways
